title: 序章19 贵奴与贵族序章20 新的生活
content_zh:
一路的颠簸，黎木也算是摸了透了眼前的男孩。
男孩体内拥有少量的贵族血脉，所以发色偏向于金色。
马尔提雅人虽然耳毛旺盛，但细细打理，也是发展出了更繁荣的耳饰文化。
不过男孩耳朵的质地与一般马尔提雅人大不相同，反而类似蝴蝶的翅膀一样，轻薄且亮丽，耳毛也是类似蝴蝶翅膀上的绒毛一般。
据说，这是北方贵族的特征。
男孩性格并没有多复杂与麻木，正常哄一哄就能套出不少情报。
身体也还算“厚实”
，至少骨头没那么明显，黎木由此推测，贵奴的生活，应该会比劣奴好不少。
“叮~”
一声奇怪的铃声响起。
刚刚还滔滔不绝的迪克突然安静了下来。
“新来的，别发呆了，跟我下车。”
男孩的声音响起。
黎木谄媚的点了点头，丝毫没有因为对方的年龄而表现出看不起对方。
能够靠嘴皮子和神态获得的好处，远比你想的来的有用且容易。
“碰~”
马尔提雅人的马车，基本都是按照一米五、一米六的身高设计的。
也许是因为过度集中于表情的把控。
黎木一时不察，竟然磕了一下脑袋。
“后辈，该学习的地方多着呢。”

迪克低声说道，虽然表情很克制，但黎木能感受到他的幸灾乐祸。
“啊，对对对，前辈说的是。”
黎木谄笑的点了点头。
原本以为话痨的迪克还会说什么，结果却没有任何回应。
自己背后反而被迪克按了一把：“快，趴下去，大人要下车了。”
话音刚落，两人顺势趴到地上。
黎木也知道，这时候的尊严和命，自己只能选一个。
“咚咚咚~”
随着木板上的踏步声响起。
一位肥硕酷似河马的女人从宽阔的后车厢缓缓走了出来。
刚一走出车厢，地上就有两名奴隶赶忙爬过去，蜷缩起身子，为其充当台阶。
还好，贵奴是没有这个规矩的。
content_en:
During the bumpy journey, Li Mu finally got to know the boy in front of him.
The boy has a small amount of noble blood in his body, so his hair color tends to be golden.
Although the Martian people have strong ear hair, they take care of it carefully and develop a more prosperous ear jewelry culture.
However, the texture of the boy's ears is very different from that of ordinary Maltiya people. Instead, it is like the wings of a butterfly, thin and bright, and the ear hairs are also similar to the fluff on the wings of a butterfly.
It is said that this is a characteristic of the northern aristocracy.
The boy's personality is not that complicated or insensitive, and he can get out a lot of information with a normal coaxing.
The body is also quite "thick"
, at least the bones are not that obvious. From this, Li Mu speculates that the life of noble slaves should be much better than that of inferior slaves.
"Ding~"
A strange ringing sound rang.
Dick, who had been talking endlessly just now, suddenly became quiet.
"Newcomer, don't be in a daze and get off the bus with me."
The boy's voice sounded.
Li Mu nodded obsequiously, not showing any contempt for the other person because of his age.
The benefits that can be obtained through words and demeanor are far more useful and easier than you think.
"touch~"
The carriages of the Martian people are basically designed according to the height of 1.5 meters and 1.6 meters.
Maybe it’s because I focus too much on controlling my expression.
Li Mu accidentally knocked his head.
"Junior, there is a lot to learn."
Dick whispered. Although his expression was restrained, Li Mu could feel his gloating.
"Ah, yes, yes, that's what senior said."
Li Mu nodded with a smile.
I originally thought that the talkative Dick would say something else, but in the end there was no response.
Instead, Dick pressed him on his back: "Quick, get down, the adults are getting off the car."
As soon as the words fell, the two of them fell to the ground.
Li Mu also knew that he could only choose between dignity and life at this time.
"Dong dong dong~"
With the sound of footsteps on the wooden board.
A plump woman who resembled a hippopotamus slowly walked out of the wide rear compartment.
As soon as he stepped out of the carriage, two slaves hurriedly crawled over and curled up on the ground to act as steps for him.
Fortunately, noble slaves don't have this rule.
